title: Add supersession and bare-cite passes to verify_summaries.py
description:
Part of math-n5d. verify_summaries.py has two blind spots, both measured on 2026-10-09.

(1) It structurally cannot see a superseded manuscript. The 2026-10-07 upstream update leaves superseded preprints/ dirs on disk and git-tracked (749 dirs on disk, 719 named by overview.tex, 30 named by no family), so a page whose anchors all resolve and whose quotations are verbatim stays green while describing a manuscript the catalog no longer lists for that family. Family 010 is exactly that: 0 problems, superseded. Add a pass requiring the page's declared manuscript root to be named by its own family in overview.tex, and flagging any preprints/ dir the page names that overview.tex assigns to a different family.

(2) It cannot catch a stale bare cite. A marker with no quoted span is checked only for non-blank endpoints, so page 221's [S1:5247] (a CONTENTS.md blurb anchor) read green while pointing at the wrong family block; fixed by hand to [S1:5220]. Add a pass requiring a bare marker's cited line to fall inside the block its page's family owns in that file.

Add a mutant for each class: retarget a File cell to a superseded sibling dir, and shift a bare blurb anchor by the CONTENTS.md -27 drift. Acceptance: plain run exits 0 over the 14 current pages, --mutant flags the full list including the two new mutants, and the new passes flag all 7 superseded pages.

title: Render generated notes files from jinja2 templates so counts cannot drift
description:
# Goal

Turn every 100%-generated file in `notes/` into a template rendered by a script, so a count in a
page is a **rendered value** rather than a typed literal that a later batch silently invalidates.

## Why

The 2026-10-07 upstream merge (three withdrawn manuscripts, 13 proof repairs, 13 citation-only
re-issues, 11 new formalizations) moved almost every headline count in the ledger: 722 → 719
manuscripts, 162 → 173 `sources:` ids, 235 → 242 scope notes, 405 → 416 challenges, 185/178 →
200/189 `main_results`, 12 → 21 summary pages, tiers 127/108/0/137 → 136/106/0/130. Sweeping that
by hand through 26 `notes/*.md` pages, `AGENTS.md`, and 40 checker scripts is the expensive part of
the merge, and it is the same work every upstream release will repeat.

Two failure classes showed up in one pass, both caused by counts living in prose:

1. **Stale literals.** Every page quotes counts typed by hand; the checkers catch drift only
   because each one re-derives the figure and compares (`Pass C` in `verify_abstracts.py`: 45 count
   phrases). Detection is per-page and post-hoc — the fix is always a manual edit.
2. **Stale generated artifacts.** `build_index.py` writes pages and never removes ones whose slug
   changed, so the merge left 3 orphan pages on disk (`032-…-and-products-of-k3-surfaces`,
   `157-counterexamples-to-the-hadwiger-and-colin-de-verdi-ere-conjectures`,
   `341-donaldsons-hypersymplectic-deformation-conjecture`) whose manuscript tables point at the
   withdrawn family-032 directories: 6 broken links, found only by `check_index_links.py`. A
   generated tree that is not a true mirror of its inputs is the same bug as a stale count.

## Inventory (measured 2026-10-08, `ls`/`find` over `notes/`)

- **Fully generated (template candidates, no hand content):** `notes/index/` — 1,036 `.md` pages +
  16 `.tsv` tables, all written by `notes/scripts/build_index.py`.
- **Fully generated tables:** `notes/catalog.tsv`, `notes/subfindings.tsv`, `notes/sources.tsv`,
  `notes/links.tsv`, `notes/abstracts.tsv`, `notes/formalization-deps.tsv` (6 of the 8 `notes/*.tsv`).
- **Mixed — hand-authored columns + generated columns:** `notes/topics.tsv` (hand-authored
  `term`/`pattern`/`status`/`note`; generated `fams`/`title`/`abstract`/`scope`/`path`),
  `notes/conjecture-standing.tsv` (hand-authored prior + release-claim columns).
- **Hand-written pages whose numbers are report-fed** (the real target — prose stays hand-written,
  every count becomes a rendered placeholder): `sources.md` (31 count phrases),
  `abstracts.md` (45), `named-results.md` (64), `index-design.md` (82 count and byte phrases),
  `counterexample-crosscheck.md` (19), `t0-chains.md` (12 + 2 tables), `subfinding-pairs.md`
  (10 Summary-table numbers), `scope-exclusions.md` (7 Measurements-table numbers),
  `dependency-drift.md` (23-row patch table), `verification-dirs.md`, `topics.md` (92-row yield
  table), `links.md`, `proof-density.md`, `names.md`, `index-links.md`, `README.md`.
  Of 26 `notes/*.md` pages, these 16 carry the counts that drift.

## Plan

1. **Make the generator own its output tree.** Add an orphan sweep to `build_index.py`: track every
   path written, delete `notes/index/**.{md,tsv}` the build did not write, remove empty dirs, print
   the swept count. (In flight as part of the current merge sweep — record it here so the template
   work inherits it.)
2. **Extract a measurement API.** One module that returns the full measured population as a dict
   (the joins `build_catalog.py` already exposes plus the per-page measurements each checker
   re-derives), so a template has a single namespace to render from.
3. **Template the fully generated tree first.** Convert `build_index.py`'s string-building
   (`family_page`, `discipline_page`, `topic_page`, `name_page`, `README.md`) into jinja2 templates
   under `notes/templates/`. Byte-identical output is the gate — diff the rendered tree against the
   current `notes/index/` before merging.
4. **Template the report-fed pages.** For each page in the inventory above, move the prose into a
   template with `{{ m.counts.x }}` placeholders and the tables into `{% for %}` loops over the
   measured rows. Keep the hand-written reading-pass prose as template text, not as data.
5. **Re-scope the checkers.** A checker that re-derives a count to compare against a literal
   becomes a checker that (a) proves the template rendered from the current measurement (re-render
   to a temp dir and diff), and (b) keeps its quotation/anchor mutants. Mutant coverage must not
   shrink; the count-phrase gates move from "match the page" to "the page is the render".
6. **Sweep the docs.** `AGENTS.md`, `notes/README.md`, `notes/scripts/README.md` describe the
   generated/hand-written split and the per-file gates; update in the same pass, and record the
   template inventory in a tracked page.

## Acceptance

- `python3 notes/scripts/build_index.py` run twice: report identical, tree byte-identical, and
  `check_index_links.py` exits 0 with `broken links 0` on a tree with no orphan pages.
- Every templated page renders byte-identically to its current committed content on the current
  corpus (no content change in the conversion commit).
- No `notes/*.md` page in the templated set contains a typed count literal; a grep for the count
  phrases finds them only in templates and in the measurement module.
- Every checker in the templated set still flags its full mutant list (`--mutant` count unchanged).
- A simulated upstream bump (change one ledger count in a scratch copy) changes every dependent
  page by re-render alone — no manual edits.

## Non-goals

- Do not template the reading records (`t0-triage.md`, `conditional.md`, `resolution-tag.md`,
  `counterexample-tag.md`, `summaries/`): their prose is the finding, and their quotations are
  pinned to file:line anchors.
- Do not delete the checkers. Rendering proves the page matches the measurement; the checkers prove
  the measurement matches the shipped files.
- `notes/topics.tsv` and `notes/conjecture-standing.tsv` keep their hand-authored columns —
  generate only the measured columns, in place.

preprints/ is not PDF-only. Measured 2026-10-07: all 722 family directories ship the manuscript as LaTeX source — 7,729 .tex files, 501 .bib, 128 MB of source, 177 KB average per family. Every directory has exactly one PDF at its root (the manuscript, named article.pdf in most, paper.pdf/main.pdf/manuscript.pdf/final.pdf in the rest) plus a build/ tree holding the source and a README.md citation stub.

Content signals already present in the sources, counted corpus-wide: 20,449 \begin{proof}, 21,317 theorem/lemma/proposition/corollary/claim/conjecture environments, and \begin{abstract} in 722 of 722 directories. The ledger uses none of this: its abstracts come from overview.tex, and its claim shapes are derived from those abstracts alone.

Children add a source index, cross-check the two abstracts, test proof density as a ledger signal, build the citation graph, and inventory numbered results. All of it is static reading over text files: never run lake, lean, or comparator, and quote counts only from a fresh build_catalog.py report.
close_reason:
All 6 children closed; the epic's premise — that preprints/ ships readable LaTeX source, not just
PDFs — is now measured and exploited. Every artifact below is a tracked file under notes/ with its
own checker, and no lake, lean, cache get, or comparator was run anywhere in the epic.

  verify_sources.py --mutant: 0 problems, 9/9 mutants. Root rule reads 718 dirs with one
  \documentclass at line start and 4 with two; the spec's 717/5 reproduces only as a substring count.
- notes/abstracts.tsv (372 rows) + notes/abstracts.md, from compare_abstracts.py;

  0 of 372 family best matches read identical or abridged — overview.tex is a rewrite, so every

  families disagree with their overview on at least one shape.
- notes/proof-density.md + measure_proof_density.py (report-only, statistic self-test 5/5, 8/8
  mutants). Verdict: no ledger column. The two genuine density measures are null on every tier pair
  (ratio ~0.97 corpus-wide); raw counts are size-explained; direction is inverse to the naive reading.
- notes/citations.md + extract_citations.py + verify_citations.py (0 problems, 9/9 mutants). The

title: Decide the prettier scope and apply it to our markdown
description:
The pilot formatted AGENTS.md in place and the emphasis question is answered; the
file scope is not chosen. Prettier 3.9.9 is pinned in package.json.

Scope by ownership. Ours (49 files): AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, notes/*.md (26),
notes/summaries/** (21). Never format: notes/index/** (1,034 generated pages -
edit the generator), preprints/** and lean/** (release mirror), root README.md and
CONTENTS.md (release mirror), .beads/README.md (bd-generated),
.qwen/skills/**/SKILL.md (YAML frontmatter).

Measured prettier 3.9.9 behavior (pilot + 49-file shadow tree, not assumed):
* x * -> _x_ unconditionally - the markdown printer's option registry is only
{proseWrap, singleQuote}, so emphasisStar and tableSpacing are rejected as unknown
options; __c__ -> **c**; tables padded; padding stripped inside double-backtick
spans; embeddedLanguageFormatting:"off" keeps code fences verbatim; proseWrap:
"preserve" keeps our line wrapping; **strong**, backtick counts and "- " bullets
are unchanged; code spans are immune, so a checker's own quoted pattern in a code
span survives while prose emphasis does not. Two non-cosmetic behaviors: a list
continuation line can be emitted at column 0, detaching the tail of a list item,
and a prose continuation line starting with "+ " is read as a bullet and rewritten
to "- " with the rest of the paragraph re-indented (2 such lines in our scope).
Restore is not stable: converting _x_ back to *x* and re-running prettier
reproduces the formatted file byte-for-byte, so a format+restore workflow leaves
files that fail prettier --check.

Checker damage over the 21 summary pages (baseline 3589 markers, 940 spans, 0
problems, 0 undetected mutants): 29 real-page Pass C quote failures over 13 pages,
which disables the mutant gate on those pages (26 undetected mutants). Cause 1:
_x_ inside a quotation - norm() strips ** * and backticks but not _. Cause 2:
blank-line insertion around block quotes moves Pass C's "citation on the line
above" window. 5 checkers key on the literal *"..."* form and 4 use strict
single-space table regexes. 589 of the run's Pass B problems were an artifact of
symlinked release dirs in the shadow tree, not prettier.

Options put to the user: A format only the 5 files no script reads (AGENTS.md,
CLAUDE.md, notes/conjecture-standing.md, notes/proof-density.md,
notes/summaries-workflow.md); B format all 49 and adapt every checker
(emphasis-pair-scoped _ stripping in each norm(), widen the 5 *"..."* patterns,
relax the 4 table regexes); C format all 49 with a tracked restore post-pass
(breaks --check); D downgrade prettier. Config in every variant: proseWrap
"preserve" plus embeddedLanguageFormatting "off", shipped as its own tracked
.prettierrc commit.
notes: DECISION (2026-10-08): restore, not adapt. Prettier 3.9.9 formatted 47 notes/ markdown files (2927+/2878-); the plain checker run then failed 7 checkers with 79 real problems (41 verify_summaries, 30 verify_t0_chains, 4 verify_named_conjectures, 1 each verify_abstracts/verify_index_design/verify_named_results, 1 pre-existing verify_findings) and the mutant run failed 12, the dominant class being mutants that can no longer be injected. Mechanisms: norm() strips **/*/backticks/HTML/LaTeX but not _; strict table regexes require | n | with no padding; *"…" quote patterns; block-quote attribution windows. Byte rewrites measured from the diff: 720 _x_ spans, 244 *"…" -> _"…" (5 survivors, all in code spans), 2,043 padded table lines.
